say:1:1322524001:1.text: So it's all in their heads. That's a relief.
say:1:1322524001:1.source_cn: 真没想到是镇民的心理作用，那我就放心了。
say:1:1322524001:1.male: So it's all in their heads. That's a relief.
say:1:1322524001:1.female: So it's all in their heads. That's a relief.

say:2:1322524002:1.text: I'll have the guards distribute the soup to the villagers. If you're okay with it... we can tell them it has some magical properties to help them out.
say:2:1322524002:1.source_cn: 我会叫侍卫把这些滋补汤发给镇民，您不介意的话……我们可...
say:2:1322524002:1.male: I'll have the guards distribute the soup to the villagers. If you're okay with it... we can tell them it has some magical properties to help them out.
say:2:1322524002:1.female: I'll have the guards distribute the soup to the villagers. If you're okay with it... we can tell them it has some magical properties to help them out.

say:3:1322524003:1.text: I'm sure the villagers will settle down soon. Thanks for your help, Magister.
say:3:1322524003:1.source_cn: 相信很快民众的恐慌会平复，劳烦您了，魔法师大人。
say:3:1322524003:1.male: I'm sure the villagers will settle down soon. Thanks for your help, Magister.
say:3:1322524003:1.female: I'm sure the villagers will settle down soon. Thanks for your help, Magister.
